item.title: 【Requests】[REQ VID] - Demi Lovato - Special Olympics Opening Ceremony 2026
item.description:
Hi, did anyone happen to capture Demi Lovato's performance at the Special Olympics Opening Ceremony 2026 from Disney+/ESPN? (I believe it was streamed on those platforms but geolocked). There are a few copies on youtube but it has some framerate issues.

There might be a repeat broadcast of the highlights on ABC later, but I am not sure if they will include the full performances again.

Thanks in advance!
